استغيثوا (form X)
# اُسْتُغِيثُوا (ustuḡīṯū) /us.tu.ɣiː.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
# اِسْتَغِيثُوا (istaḡīṯū) /is.ta.ɣiː.θuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَغَاثَ (istaḡāṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
